description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and similarity scores for different language configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Similarity” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.45, with tick labels at 0.05 intervals.  A red solid line, labeled “en&en”, begins at approximately 0.07 at Layer 0, decreases to 0.05 at Layer 1, increases to a peak of 0.28 at Layer 3, then declines to 0.11 at Layer 18, and rises sharply to 0.43 at Layer 22. A cyan solid line, labeled “en&es”, starts at 0.06 at Layer 0, decreases to 0.04 at Layer 1, increases to 0.16 at Layer 2, then declines to 0.08 at Layer 18, and rises to 0.21 at Layer 22. A green solid line, labeled “en&el”, begins at 0.05 at Layer 0, increases to 0.10 at Layer 2, then declines to 0.06 at Layer 18, and rises to 0.12 at Layer 22. A magenta dashed line, labeled “en&bn”, starts at 0.04 at Layer 0, increases to 0.08 at Layer 2, then declines to 0.05 at Layer 18, and rises to 0.18 at Layer 22.
